WITH station_weather_groups AS (
    SELECT
        t.observstation,
        o.weathprofile,
        AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
        COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
    FROM telescopes AS t
    INNER JOIN observatories AS o
        ON o.observstation = t.observstation
    WHERE t.pointaccarc >= 4.86
    GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_of_group_avg_bandusagepct,
    AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_group_telescope_count
FROM station_weather_groups;
